title: A typed escalation (fact:escalation; a finding's escalate)
description: BS-12 (owner, 2026-10-19: review loops run without requesting human intervention unless there is ambiguity as to how to solve / a product question). The only way a lens loop or its fixer reaches a human: an agent's typed report, per finding, escalate { kind, question, options? }. 'step.review.log' copies the first valid one (adding the finding's lens and id) into fact:escalation and reports needsOwner; 'step.lens.log' (the design review, owner 2026-10-23) copies EVERY valid one of the round, in order and with no limit, as an array of these objects, so the owner answers them all in one desk; 'step.review.fix' reports needsOwner with fact:escalation itself. A finding that only says 'please decide', or has any other kind, is not an escalation and stays in the loop.

lens.description: Added by the log Step: the lens whose finding escalated.

id.description: Added by step.lens.log in the list form: q1, q2... in round order, unique within the round; an answer echoes it.

finding.description: Added by the log Step: the finding's id, when it has one.
